meta.name: BuzzFeed Celeb
meta.description:
From the latest celebrity headlines to favorite
hilariously mundane happenings, BuzzFeed is here to
keep you updated on what all your favorite celebs
are up to.

Shows: Best Of Puppy Interviews, Idris Elba, John Cena & Madelyn Cline Take The Co-Star Test, Hilary Duff & Ashley Tisdale Talk Disney Days, Sarah Paulson & Sydney Sweeney Play With Puppies, Movie & TV Castmates Play Who's Who
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
